MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.NAME: Guan Yu
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.LAST_DEED: Surrounded at Maicheng, he left the city to break through, and was ambushed and captured on the road.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.MEMORY_1: There was a man I called elder brother. For that one name I took the long road back.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.MEMORY_2: The blade was heavy. People feared me, and still looked up to me.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.MEMORY_3: That night I tried to break through. This time, in your body, I walk that road to its end.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GUANYU.TASK: Deal 30+ damage to an enemy with a single attack
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.NAME: Joan of Arc
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.SHADOW: A word not taken back, even in the fire
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.LAST_DEED: She took back the abjuration she had signed out of fear of the fire, days later. On 30 May 1431 she was burned at Rouen.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.MEMORY_1: I first heard the voices in my father's garden. No one believed me, but I heard them.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.MEMORY_2: I carried the banner into the city. The siege was lifted.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.JOAN.MEMORY_3: Before the fire I kept my word. I will not take it back this time either.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.NAME: Leonidas
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.SHADOW: The pass held, the home never reached
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.LAST_DEED: When the Persians came round behind by the mountain path, he sent most of the allies away and stayed at Thermopylae with those who remained (480 BC).
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.MEMORY_1: The shield was never for me. It was for the man standing beside me.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.MEMORY_2: In a narrow pass, it is the line that fights, not the numbers.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.MEMORY_3: I did not turn back. I do not turn back now.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.LEONIDAS.TASK: Block a total of 50+ damage in one combat
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.NAME: Genghis Khan
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.LAST_DEED: He died in 1227, during the campaign against Western Xia. The campaign was not yet over.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.MEMORY_1: There was a child on the steppe who lost everything. That child decided never to lose again.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.MEMORY_2: I bound the scattered tribes into one. The horses never rested.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.GENGHIS.MEMORY_3: The campaign is not finished. Tread its end with your own feet.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.NAME: Yi Sun-sin
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.SHADOW: A sea not yet at peace
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.LAST_DEED: At Noryang (1598), struck by a bullet, he is said to have ordered: "The battle is at its height. Do not announce my death."
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.MEMORY_1: It was people, not ships, who guarded the sea. Every day I kept a diary.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.MEMORY_2: The enemy was many and our ships were few. Still, we did not give way.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.MEMORY_3: I fell before the battle ended. This time I will see the end.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.YISUNSIN.TASK: Win an Elite or Boss combat at 50% HP or less
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.NAME: Napoleon
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.LAST_DEED: After Waterloo he was exiled to Saint Helena, and died there on 5 May 1821.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.MEMORY_1: I was born on a small island. The world was always larger than the island.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.MEMORY_2: Deciding where to place the guns was deciding the battle.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.NAPOLEON.MEMORY_3: It ended on an island. This time, I leave the island.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.CONTRACT_TEXT.RESONANCE: A soul that walked the same road. Synchronization and Focus need less Mastery.
MUMYEONG-FIGURE.CONTRACT_TEXT.GRUDGE: A soul mixed with another grain. Start each combat with 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], but cards that are not your figure's build [gold]Grudge[/gold].

MUMYEONG-THEATER.FAMINE.ACTION.GUANYU: You give your share to your soldier first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FAMINE.ACTION.JOAN: You pray and open the granary
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FAMINE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You go hungry and share grain beyond the gate
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FAMINE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You ride to raid the neighbour's granary
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FAMINE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You give grain to children and the old first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FAMINE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You make ration tickets and divide by day
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.DESC: A duel at dawn. Your opponent is your old teacher. It ends only when one falls.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.GAZE.GUANYU: You look into your teacher's eyes
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the rising sun
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the students watching the duel
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look for the gap in your teacher's guard
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at those trying to stop the duel
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You picture what comes after the duel
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.ACTION.GUANYU: You bow to your teacher before raising your blade
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.ACTION.JOAN: Told to step back, you step forward
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You take your teacher's blow on your body
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.ACTION.GENGHIS: You drive into the gap in one stroke
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You lower your blade and send the students away
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You feign defeat to save your teacher's face
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.WORDS.GUANYU: "A teacher's kindness I repay with the blade."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.DUEL.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Who remains matters more than who wins."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.DESC: An exile's island in the middle of the sea. A guard ship circles it. Tonight, a single boat will land.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the friend exiled with you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the stars over the sea
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the tired faces of the islanders
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the continent beyond the horizon
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the prisoners held on the guard ship
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You time the guard ship's circuit
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.ACTION.GUANYU: You put your friend on the boat first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.ACTION.JOAN: You do not take the boat; you stay on the island
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You draw the guard ship's eye to let the boat go
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You take the boat straight for the continent
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You free the prisoners and leave together
MUMYEONG-THEATER.EXILE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You leave the moment the guard ship turns away
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.DESC: In the command tent. A false order has come from court. Obey, and thousands die. Refuse, and you die.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the old comrade who brought the order
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the seal on the order
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.GAZE.LEONID: You look at the soldiers outside the tent
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.GAZE.GENGHI: You look at the enemy position the order names
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.GAZE.YISUNS: You look at the village the order abandons
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.GAZE.NAPOLE: You study the date and the handwriting
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.ACTION.GUAN: You ask that your comrade at least be spared
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.ACTION.JOAN: You tear up the order and take the path you believe is right
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.ACTION.LEON: You shield the soldiers and take the punishment alone
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.ACTION.GENG: You ignore the order and advance on the enemy
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.ACTION.YISU: You defy the order and defend the village
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.ACTION.NAPO: You prove the order is forged
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.WORDS.GENGH: "On the field, the field gives the orders."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.FALSE_ORDER.WORDS.YISUN: "I cannot obey an order to abandon the people."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.DESC: A flooded riverbank. The pursuers are closing in. The boat is small, and the current is strong.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at your brother waiting on the far bank
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the moon on the water
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the soldiers who will not fit in the boat
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the land beyond the river
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the refugees left on the bank
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You look for the slowest ford
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.ACTION.GUANYU: You plunge into the river to reach your brother
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.ACTION.JOAN: You stand on the bank to the end, waving the banner
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You give up the boat and hold off the pursuers
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.ACTION.GENGHIS: You drive your horse through the raging river
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You put the refugees in the boat first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You find the ford and lead everyone across in a line
MUMYEONG-THEATER.RIVER.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Water flows to the lowest place. So will we."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.DESC: A tribunal. The witness has lied. Just before the verdict, you are given one chance to speak.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the friend trying to testify for you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the sky beyond the window
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at those dragged here with you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the power behind the judges
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the families in the gallery
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You search the witness's words for a contradiction
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.ACTION.GUANYU: You stop your friend from testifying
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.ACTION.JOAN: You speak the truth without bending a word
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.ACTION.LEONIDA: You say you alone bear all the guilt
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.ACTION.GENGHIS: You storm out of the court
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.ACTION.YISUNSI: You plead the others' innocence first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.ACTION.NAPOLEO: You point out the witness's contradictions one by one
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.WORDS.GENGHIS: "You have no right to judge me."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TRIBUNAL.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Law is the victor's weapon. Today I will wield it."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.DESC: The enemy commander holds a hostage. Lay down your arms, and they will be released. You cannot trust it.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at your sworn brother, now a hostage
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the rosary in the hostage's hand
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the soldiers waiting behind you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look past the commander to the enemy camp
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the villagers bound with the hostage
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You read the commander's eyes and trembling hand
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.ACTION.GUANYU: You drop your weapon and walk forward alone
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.ACTION.JOAN: You keep your weapon and approach in prayer
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You offer yourself as hostage instead
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.ACTION.GENGHIS: You strike while the commander is speaking
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You negotiate to free the villagers first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You send soldiers around to cut off the commander's retreat
MUMYEONG-THEATER.HOSTAGE.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "You have already lost. You just don't know it yet."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.DESC: The last camp after a defeat. By tomorrow the encirclement will close. The remaining soldiers look only to you.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at your old comrade by the fire
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.GAZE.JOAN: You look at a star between the clouds
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the land beyond the encirclement
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at a young soldier asleep
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You trace the remaining roads on the map
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.ACTION.GUANYU: You share a last cup with your comrade
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.ACTION.JOAN: You gather everyone to pray together
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.ACTION.LEONID: You lead the rear guard so the wounded can escape
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.ACTION.GENGHI: You break the encirclement head-on under cover of night
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.ACTION.YISUNS: You send the young soldiers home
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.ACTION.NAPOLE: You light false campfires to fool the enemy and slip away
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.WORDS.GUANYU: "We swore to die on the same day."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.WORDS.LEONIDA: "Do not worry about what is behind me."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.LAST_CAMP.WORDS.NAPOLEO: "They will believe we are still here."
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.DESC: The top of a collapsing tower. The stairs are gone and fire climbs from below. The next tower might be one leap away.
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.GAZE.GUANYU: You look at the comrade trapped with you
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.GAZE.JOAN: You look at the open sky above the tower
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.GAZE.LEONIDAS: You look at the floor splitting apart
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.GAZE.GENGHIS: You look at the other tower
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.GAZE.YISUNSIN: You look at the people trapped below
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.GAZE.NAPOLEON: You measure the gap between the towers
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.ACTION.GUANYU: You throw your comrade across first
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.ACTION.JOAN: You look down into the fire and stand unafraid
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.ACTION.LEONIDAS: You hold up the failing floor so others can cross
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.ACTION.GENGHIS: You leap first and reach the other side
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.ACTION.YISUNSIN: You lower a rope and pull up those below
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.ACTION.NAPOLEON: You find a way to bridge the towers
MUMYEONG-THEATER.TOWER.WORDS.NAPOLEON: "Even a falling tower can be a stepping stone."
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.title: The Underworld Projection Room
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.des:
Blackout.
Your heart beats twice.

[gold]You will die in one second.[/gold]

...The whir of a projector. Three shadows sit in the dark seats. Their names cannot be seen; above each floats only what they carry.
{Shadows}
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.DESCENT.des:
{Reaction}The film stops. The shadow of [gold]"{Shadow}"[/gold] rises from its seat.
It walks into the screen, and its name is revealed.

[gold]{Figure}[/gold]
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.DESCENT.opt: Your last second and theirs are screened side by side.
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.REVEAL.opti: Make the contract. Their 2 cards join your deck, and you learn one of their techniques.
Your heart beats again. But now the beat belongs to two.
[gold]{Figure}[/gold] — {Contract}
MUMYEONG-THEATER_EVENT.pages.NO_CORE.des: The film snapped. The seats are empty.
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.title: The Next Reel
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.de:
Somewhere, a projector starts again. One cut of [gold]{Figure}[/gold]'s memory appears on the screen.

"{Memory}"

The soul steps one stage deeper — [gold]{Stage}[/gold].
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.pages.NOTHING.de: The projector is silent. It is not yet time for the next reel.
MUMYEONG-STAGE_UP_EVENT.pages.DONE.descr: The reel ran to its end. You and [gold]{Figure}[/gold] reached [gold]{Stage}[/gold].
